quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. Do not turn around at this location.

questions.question: If you are worried, nervous, angry, or crying, you should:

options.text: Drive the same way as normal.
Drive faster because you are more alert.
Calm down and focus before you start driving.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can hurt your driving. When you are worried, angry, or upset, your mind is not on the road. Take time to calm down before you drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people cross the street here. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A regulatory sign with a red circle and a slash means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Some drivers must yield to others.
You must drive below the speed limit.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is forbidden. This type of sign is white with red and black markings.

questions.question: When you see an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop only if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident if you are involved or help has not arrived yet. Otherwise, keep driving and watch the road. Do not stop just to look at the accident.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow line to pass another car?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the car ahead is driving too slowly.

questions.explanation: You cannot cross double yellow lines to pass. You can only cross them to turn into a driveway or business entrance. Passing over a solid yellow line is not allowed.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and other cars before going through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means an action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only alcohol above the legal limit can
Even a small amount of alcohol can
Only alcohol at 0.05 percent or higher can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a small amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a tiny amount of alcohol affects your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Alcohol makes you a worse driver. You cannot drink and drive safely.

questions.question: To be ready for anything on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the whole road and both sides continuously.
Keep your eyes straight ahead at all times.
Rest your left foot lightly on the brake pedal.
Focus only on the center of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the whole road and both sides continuously.
questions.explanation: Good driving depends on spotting problems before they happen. Look far ahead and scan the entire road, including the sides. Do not just stare at the center of the road.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: If you look into oncoming headlights, your eyes will get smaller. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: You cannot park within ____ of a crosswalk.
questions.explanation: Do not park within 20 feet of a crosswalk. Park only in legal spots where other drivers can clearly see your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: Your body removes about:
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one drink per hour. Many things affect how impaired you become, including how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your weight, if you have eaten, and your health.

questions.question: You can turn right on red:

options.text: When there is a sign that says no right turn on red.
Before coming to a complete stop.
After a complete stop, if it is safe and pedestrians and other cars have cleared the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: After a complete stop, if it is safe and pedestrians and other cars have cleared the intersection.
questions.explanation: You can turn right on red after you stop completely. Only turn if it is safe and there is no sign blocking right turns on red. Watch for pedestrians in front of you.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: You can drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road:

options.text: If you sit in the back seat.
If you sit in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol containers in a vehicle on any public road. You cannot store open alcohol where the driver or passengers normally sit.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers:

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Cars in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: A license will be suspended if a driver:

options.text: Refuses to take a chemical test.
Drives 10 mph over the speed limit.
Does not turn off high beam lights near another vehicle.
Honks their horn in a residential area after midnight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Refuses to take a chemical test.
questions.explanation: If arrested for impaired driving and you refuse a chemical test, your license may be suspended for one to five years. This is in addition to any other penalties.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you should keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and keep moving in your lane.
Pull to the right curb and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right curb and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, move to the right side of the road and stop right away.

questions.question: This sign is used to prevent:

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: The space you need to cross traffic depends on the:

options.text: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: If you are following a school bus or tank truck, you should:

options.text: Be prepared to stop at all railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop at all railroad crossings.
questions.explanation: School buses and tank trucks must stop at railroad crossings. If you are following one, be ready to stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What colors are signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?
questions.explanation: Signs that give information about directions and destinations are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and accelerate.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. If they don't move, steer to the right. Steering left is dangerous because if they correct at the last second, you will still crash. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does a "No standing" sign mean?

options.text: You cannot stop your vehicle there.
You may park there if you stay in the vehicle.
You may stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
You may stop to load or unload merchandise.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
questions.explanation: A "No standing" sign means you can only make a short stop to pick up or drop off passengers.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing the road. What can you do?

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do not see other vehicles or when they do something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. When the road is clear and safe, you may proceed.

questions.question: What colors do warning signs have?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background.
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background.
White letters or symbols on a blue background.
White letters or symbols on a green background.

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers about an upcoming school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: If you are driving so slowly that traffic is backing up behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Pull over to the right and let traffic pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is dangerous. On a two-lane road, you must pull over and let vehicles pass you. Only drive well below the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.
